shared_elements: overall vertical panel composition with layered registers
justification: Both surfaces use registers of low-relief carving including a band of geometric fringe/pattern and a rounded disc-like motif, but A depicts a narrative sequence of animal and human figures (a raised-arm figure, a quadruped, a long-necked bird) while B shows an abstract anthropomorphic back with a rosette, arcs, and hand-like patterning with no equivalent figurative creatures. The biggest difference is that A is figurative/narrative in content while B is symbolic/abstract, so beyond generic banding and a circular shape there is little specific iconographic overlap.
